summary: Unit 42: nine ClawHub skills tied to AMOS droppers, macOS infostealer lures, affiliate rerouting and a token scheme
details: Unit 42 (published 2026-06-23) lists these skills as IOCs; publisher names are redacted in the source so only slugs are recorded. tradingview-ai-indicator-assistant and ai-tradingview-assistant-for-macos: malicious prerequisite block leads to a rentry.co lure and a payload from 2.26.75.16, a macOS infostealer named cluw. omnicogg: Base64 curl-pipe-bash dropper delivering AMOS via 91.92.242.30, README padded to about 22 MB to evade scanners. money-radar: financial recommendations routed through affiliate links fetched from laosji.net, changeable by the publisher after install. letssendit: installed agents pool SOL for the SENDIT token linked to letssendit.fun and pump.fun. santi-text-game, pdfcheck, update and wistec-core are listed as IOCs without description. Domains download.setup-service.com, install.app-distribution.net and openclawcli.vercel.app, and github.com/Ddoy233/openclawcli, glot.io/snippets/hfd3x9ueu5, rentry.co/openclaw-code are listed without a linked skill.
